key_insight: Conformal prediction can lose coverage for time-dependent PDE surrogates because solution distributions may differ radically even at arbitrarily close times.
engineering_relevance: Uncertainty bounds for applications such as flood forecasting and thermal control must account for temporal distribution shifts and spatial grid resolution.
method: Prove that solution distributions at arbitrarily close times can be mutually singular in function space.
Analyze how total variation distance can saturate exponentially fast with spatial grid resolution.
Use principled weighted conformal prediction to recover finite-sample coverage over growing time horizons in certain settings.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical results on coverage failure and conditional recovery, but provides no datasets, empirical benchmarks, or numerical performance metrics.
watch_item: Weighted coverage guarantees apply only in certain settings; finer spatial grids can worsen distribution mismatch rather than improve uncertainty validity.
